jobs.title: Director, Product Learning & Development
jobs.description:
Apptronik is a human-centered robotics company developing AI-powered robots to support humanity in every facet of life. Our flagship humanoid robot, Apollo, is built to collaborate thoughtfully with people, starting with critical industries such as manufacturing and logistics, with future applications in healthcare, the home, and beyond.

We operate at the cutting edge of Applied AI, applying our expertise across the full robotics stack to solve some of society's most important problems. You will join a team dedicated to bringing Apollo to market at scale, tackling the complex challenges like safety, commercialization, and mass production to change the world for the better.

Full Time | Global Services & Support | Austin, Texas

JOB SUMMARY

Reporting to the Senior Vice President of Global Services and Support, the Director, Product Learning & Development is the executive architect of Apptronik’s global learning and knowledge strategy. Reporting directly to the SVP of Global Services & Support, you are responsible for building the end-to-end education ecosystem that transforms complex robotics technology into accessible, scalable expertise for our global workforce, partners, and customers.

This is a high-impact "builder" role for a seasoned leader who understands that successful robotics integration requires far more than just mechanical knowledge. You will create and lead a world-class team to build an engine for Operational & Launch Readiness, ensuring that everyone in the Apptronik ecosystem, from our internal support engineers to our customers’ robot supervisors and global partners, possesses the product mastery, change-management literacy, and deep understanding of the customer-transformation journey required to succeed.

You will build the definitive library and knowledge-based learning ecosystem that drives customer confidence, accelerates product adoption, and creates passionate brand advocates. Your team is responsible for architecting persona-based learning pathways and competency frameworks for every individual who interacts with, monitors, or manages our robotic solutions.

The GSS Mindset

In Global Services & Support, we don’t just "fix things". We deliver confidence, at scale.

- Customer-First Obsession: You don’t just resolve tasks; you prioritize the human experience. Every build, fix, or workflow is measured by its impact on the people who rely on our technology.

- The Ultimate Partner: You are a collaborator at your core. You act as the essential bridge between the "messy reality" of the field and our internal ambitions, building trust across departments to ensure a unified effort.

- Operational Evolution: You don't just follow a process; you own it. You find joy in creating order where none exists and possess the discipline to constantly "improve the system."

- Dynamic Adaptability: You thrive in a "small-team" environment. You are a true team player who is comfortable wearing multiple hats and navigating fast-paced change with patience and a relentless focus on the solution. We are the shepherds of chaos.

- The Culture Catalyst: You are the person everyone wants on their project team. You bring a "solution-first" energy to every interaction, acting as a cultural ambassador who elevates the morale and standards of those around you. You understand that how we work together is just as important as the work itself.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES or KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES:

Strategic Governance & Business Impact

- Global Vision & Roadmap: Define and own the multi-year strategic roadmap for internal technical readiness, field deployment, and external customer/partner enablement. Ensure our educational framework scales alongside Apptronik’s global expansion and rapid product release cycles.

- Operational Excellence & P&L: Manage the functional budget as a high-yield investment. Establish and report on business-critical metrics, including Support Deflection, Time-to-Value (TTV), Certification rates, and Launch Readiness, directly to executive leadership.

- Commercialization: Partner with Go-To-Market (GTM), Product, and Commercial teams to architect, price, and commercialize tiered training packages and professional certification tracks that contribute directly to GSS margins.

- Ecosystem Architecture: Architect and oversee Apptronik’s multi-tenant Learning Tech Stack (LMS/LXP/Sandbox). Integrate learning directly with CRM, CS, and Support tools to establish a unified, 360-degree view of user proficiency and product adoption.

Programmatic & Technical Leadership

- High-Stakes Curricula & Launch Readiness: Oversee the creation of technical learning programs that go beyond basic maintenance to include robot supervision, teleoperation, and safety. Drive "Deployment Readiness" frameworks aligned to New Product Introductions (NPI).

- AI-Enabled & Simulation Learning: Drive the adoption of modern, AI-powered learning tools, digital twins, and virtual "Sandbox" environments for risk-free, high-fidelity mastery, delivering performance support directly "in the flow of work."

- Certification Engine & Competency Models: Architect a "Gold Standard" Global Certification program and define persona-based competency models for internal Field Engineers, partners, and customer operators worldwide.

- Documentation Partnership: Act as a strategic stakeholder for Technical Documentation to ensure manuals, release notes, and instructional content are perfectly synchronized as a single source of truth.

Organizational Leadership & Culture

- Scale the Org: Recruit, mentor, and lead a high-performing management layer, building the functional muscle of the team and fostering the growth of technical trainers, instructional designers, and e-learning developers.

- Executive Liaison: Serve as a vital bridge between GSS, Product, Engineering, and Commercial Transformation teams to embed the "Learning Loop" into the product development lifecycle.

- Product Insights & Advocacy: Synthesize learner analytics, field observations, and user feedback to advocate for product "learnability," working with Engineering to reduce operational friction through better out-of-box design.

- Change Management: Lead the cultural shift that transforms training from a reactive support function into a proactive business driver for human-robot operational literacy.

SKILLS AND REQUIREMENTS

- The "Architect's" Vision: Proven capability to design modern, multi-tenant learning ecosystems (combining LMS, LXP, AI-driven content, and simulated Sandbox environments) optimized for both structured certification and on-demand field support.

- Human-Robot Interface Literacy: Deep understanding that bringing humanoid or advanced robotics into a customer environment requires change management, supervisory skills, and workflow redesign, not just a mechanical manual.

- Commercial & Launch Mindset: Ability to treat learning as a margin-generating, churn-reducing business driver and tie education directly to commercial product launches and deployment speed.

- Cross-Functional Magnetism: Executive presence and technical credibility to command respect from deep hardware/software engineers, GTM leaders, and C-suite stakeholders alike.

- Creating Structure: Thrive in fast-paced, high-growth hardware/software environments where ambiguity is high and processes must be built from scratch.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE:

- ~10 years of progressive leadership experience in Technical Training, Product L&D, Customer Education, or Technical Enablement within high-growth robotics, hardware-plus-software, or industrial tech environments.

- 5+ years of director-level management experience, with a proven track record of managing managers and leading multi-disciplinary technical teams.

- 0-to-1 Track Record: Demonstrated success building a global product education or enablement function from the ground up in a rapidly scaling organization.

- Business & Financial Acumen: Deep understanding of complex B2B SaaS/Hardware business models, with a proven ability to link learning metrics directly to P&L performance (ROI, NRR, support deflection).

- Executive Presence: Exceptional communication and influencing skills with the confidence to drive alignment across C-Suite and SVP levels.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

Hybrid Role based in Austin, Texas

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

- Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer

- Vision to read printed materials and a computer screen

- Hearing and speech to communicate

*This is a direct hire.  Please, no outside Agency solicitations.

jobs.description:

You will join a team dedicated to bringing Apollo to market at scale, tackling the complex challenges like safety, commercialization, and mass production to change the world for the better.

JOB SUMMARY

The Senior Compensation Business Partner is a key contributor to Apptronik's Total Rewards team, responsible for the analysis, market data, and program administration that support our pay strategy. You will work independently on complex compensation analyses, act as a go-to resource for People Partners and business leaders on pay questions, and help evolve the compensation programs and tools that support a rapidly growing technical workforce

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES or KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES:

- Conduct job evaluations and leveling assessments across multiple job families, ensuring alignment with Apptronik's career ladder and market standards

- Manage participation in compensation surveys and analyze the results to inform competitive pay positioning

- Provide consultative support to People Partners, recruiters, and business leaders on pay decisions, offer guidance, job architecture, and policy interpretation

- Analyze compensation data and develop insights and recommendations on salary structures, pay equity, and incentive plan design

- Support the design and administration of salary structures, merit cycles, and bonus and equity programs

- Support compliance with pay-related regulations (e.g., FLSA, pay transparency laws) and assist with audits and compliance reviews

- Contribute to cross-functional projects such as compensation redesigns, technology implementations, and organizational changes that affect pay

- Prepare and present compensation analyses and recommendations to People and business leaders

- Build and maintain compensation models, tools, and documentation, and share knowledge with teammates

- Stay current on industry trends and competitive practices, and bring forward ideas for improving our programs

SKILLS AND REQUIREMENTS

- Working knowledge of compensation strategy, market pricing, job architecture, and pay equity

- Solid understanding of compensation compliance (e.g., FLSA, pay transparency) and the ability to spot risk and raise it early

- Advanced Excel skills and experience with compensation systems and market data sources (e.g., Radford, Pave, Workday)

- Clear communication and presentation skills, with the ability to advise and influence non-compensation partners

- Strong organization and the ability to manage multiple projects independently in a fast-paced,
matrixed environment

- Comfort with ambiguity and change, and a bias toward practical, data-driven improvements

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE:

- Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, Finance, or a related field

- 5+ years of compensation experience in progressively responsible roles

- CCP (Certified Compensation Professional) certification preferred

- Experience in technology, robotics, life sciences, or other competitive global industries is a plus

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

- Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer

- Vision to read printed materials and a computer screen

- Hearing and speech to communicate

jobs.title: Senior Director, Total Rewards
jobs.description:
Apptronik is a human-centered robotics company developing AI-powered robots to support humanity in every facet of life. Our flagship humanoid robot, Apollo, is built to collaborate thoughtfully with people, starting with critical industries such as manufacturing and logistics, with future applications in healthcare, the home, and beyond.

We operate at the cutting edge of Applied AI, applying our expertise across the full robotics stack to solve some of society's most important problems. You will join a team dedicated to bringing Apollo to market at scale, tackling the complex challenges like safety, commercialization, and mass production to change the world for the better.

Senior Director, Total Rewards

Full-Time  |  People Operations  |  Austin, Texas (Hybrid)

JOB SUMMARY

Apptronik is building robots that will change how humanity works — and we’re building the people function to match. As our Director, Total Rewards, you’ll be a founding architect of how we attract, reward, and retain world-class talent in one of the most competitive markets on the planet. You’ll own compensation and benefits strategy end-to-end, partnering with Finance, Legal, and People Partners, and reporting to the VP, People Operations. Level will be calibrated to your experience and what you’re ready to own from day one.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES or KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES:

Compensation Design & Management

- Own job architecture, leveling frameworks, and salary structures across engineering, business, and operations functions

- Lead compensation cycles (merit, equity refresh, promotions), including modeling, calibration, and manager communications

- Conduct regular market benchmarking using Radford or comparable surveys; maintain salary bands and refresh annually

- Partner with Talent Acquisition on offer strategy, competitive positioning, and real-time compensation intelligence

Equity Compensation

- Partner with Legal and Finance on equity mechanics, liquidity events, and board materials; build education resources that help employees understand and value their ownership

Benefits & Well-being

- Own the full benefits lifecycle — broker relationships, annual renewal, plan design, cost modeling, and employee communication; serve as the escalation point for complex claims and coverage questions

- Evaluate and evolve the benefits portfolio to remain competitive in the tech and robotics talent market

- Oversee leave of absence administration and ensure compliance with applicable federal and state regulations

Compliance & Governance

- Ensure programs comply with FLSA, ACA, ERISA, and applicable state laws; maintain plan documents, SPDs, and governance documentation

Analytics & Systems

- Build dashboards and conduct pay equity analyses that give leadership clear visibility into total rewards spend and support a fair, data-informed workplace

SKILLS AND REQUIREMENTS

- Total Rewards Depth: 12+ years in compensation, total rewards, or a related people operations role, ideally in a high-growth or tech environment. Breadth across comp strategy, equity, and benefits matters more than any single credential.

- Analytical Mindset: You build models, identify trends, and translate complex data into clear insights for Finance, Legal, and Board-level audiences.

- Builder’s Instinct: You bring structure to ambiguity and take ownership through to execution — no playbook required.

- Clear Communicator: You handle sensitive data with discretion and translate complex comp concepts into plain language for employees, managers, and executives alike.

- CHIPC Values: You naturally embody our core values ( C uriosity, H umility, I ntegrity, P assion, and C reativity) — how we make decisions every day.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE:

- 12+ years in compensation, total rewards, or a combined people operations role

- Bachelor’s degree in HR, Business, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

- CCP, CEBS, or PHR/SPHR certification is a plus, not a requirement

- Experience in a venture-backed or high-growth company strongly preferred; transferable depth from other dynamic environments welcome

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

- Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer

- Vision to read printed materials and a computer screen

- Hearing and speech to communicate

jobs.title: Strategy & Operations Associate
jobs.description:
Apptronik is a human-centered robotics company developing AI-powered robots to support humanity in every facet of life. Our flagship humanoid robot, Apollo, is built to collaborate thoughtfully with people, starting with critical industries such as manufacturing and logistics, with future applications in healthcare, the home, and beyond.

We operate at the cutting edge of Applied AI, applying our expertise across the full robotics stack to solve some of society's most important problems. You will join a team dedicated to bringing Apollo to market at scale, tackling the complex challenges like safety, commercialization, and mass production to change the world for the better.

JOB SUMMARY

The Strategy & Operations Associate is a high-potential generalist in Customer Transformation & Deployments (CTD), the team that owns commercial strategy, transformation and deployments, pricing, competitive insights, and market expansion. Acting as the team’s analytical pinch hitter, you will pick up the most urgent problem, structure it from first principles, run the analysis, and deliver a clear recommendation that shapes pricing, deals, and strategy. This is a development role by design, with a path to leading a vertical and broad executive exposure, and it is built for someone who thrives in ambiguity and learns fast.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES or KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES

- Build models and fact bases for pricing and deal economics, ROI/business cases, market sizing, and use case prioritization.

- Structure ambiguous questions into hypotheses, test them with data, and deliver clear, actionable recommendations.

- Maintain data templates and KPI tracking so insights are repeatable across engagements.

- Flex across commercial strategy, deal analysis, pricing, and competitive insights based on business priority.

- Own discrete workstreams end-to-end, such as competitor profiles, pricing inputs, and healthcare value chain mapping.

- Connect cross-vertical patterns to sharpen decisions across the Customer Transformation team.

- Support engagements and transformation-led sales cycles with analysis, value sizing, and KPI definition.

- Prepare leadership and board content; track quarterly KPIs and flag risks early.

- Feed engagement learnings into playbooks, pricing, and competitive intelligence.

- Rotate across one primary and one support vertical (reassessed quarterly) to build range across insights, pricing, delivery, healthcare, and strategy.

SKILLS AND REQUIREMENTS

- First-principles thinker who structures ambiguous problems, builds models from scratch, and pressure-tests assumptions.

- Strong quantitative skills, including advanced Excel/Sheets; SQL or BI a plus.

- Ability to produce executive-ready materials and clear recommendations.

- Exposure to pricing, market sizing, competitive analysis, or customer transformation.

- Self-starter comfortable switching context and influencing without authority.

- Interest in healthcare, manufacturing, or logistics a plus; AI/robotics experience a plus, not required.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE

- 2–4 years of experience in management consulting (Associate to Senior Associate), strategy & operations, BizOps, finance, or a comparable analytical role.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

- Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer

- Must be able to lift 15 pounds at times

- Vision to read printed materials and a computer screen

- Hearing and speech to communicate

- Occasional travel to and within client sites (i.e., factories, hospitals, etc.)

*This is a direct hire.  Please, no outside Agency solicitations.
